outcome: postnatal diagnosis (LUTO, non-LUTO, normal urinary tract)
cohort: The study included 27 fetuses (26 male) diagnosed with megacystis (defined as longitudinal bladder diameter >7mm in the first trimester or an overdistended/thickened-walled bladder failing to empty in the second/third trimesters).
finding: Prenatal parameters like upper tract dilatation, keyhole sign, oligohydramnios, LBD, and GA at diagnosis were not predictive of postnatal diagnosis (LUTO vs. non-LUTO) or postnatal renal function, though megacystis diagnosed in the second and third trimesters was associated with live births in 85% of cases.
gest_age: Mean gestational age of live births was 34 +/- 2 weeks.
